scenes.description: Hook: 'That spider web isn't decoration. It's a map.'
One sheet of steel; two clashing notes buzz and fight through the metal.
The map splits them: clashing notes to opposite sides, friendly notes side by side.
Payoff: that's why a steelpan rings clean instead of rattling.
Anthony Williams worked it out. Trinidad, 1953.
'Every lead pan still follows his drawing.' + end tag.
